architecture_metadata.name: AlexNet
ideas: ReLU activations instead of saturating nonlinearities
dropout in the fully connected layers
large early convolution kernels (11x11 stride 4)
GPU training at ImageNet scale
architecture_metadata.addressed: Showed that deep CNNs beat hand-engineered features, which is the result that ended the feature-engineering era.

architecture_metadata.name: VGG16
ideas: stacked 3x3 convolutions in place of large kernels
uniform, very deep sequential design
very large parameter count concentrated in the dense layers
architecture_metadata.addressed: Replaced AlexNet's large kernels with stacks of small ones, gaining depth and receptive field at lower parameter cost per layer - but ballooning the fully connected head.

architecture_metadata.name: GoogLeNet
ideas: Inception modules with parallel branches
several receptive-field sizes in one layer
1x1 convolutions as cheap dimensionality reduction
global average pooling instead of a huge dense head
architecture_metadata.addressed: Attacked VGG's parameter cost directly: width and multi-scale features instead of depth alone, at a fraction of the parameters.

architecture_metadata.name: ResNet18
ideas: residual connections
identity skip paths that preserve gradient flow
batch normalization throughout
architecture_metadata.addressed: Solved the degradation problem: past roughly twenty layers, plain deep networks got *worse*, and skip connections made depth trainable again.

architecture_metadata.name: ResNet50

greater depth at controlled parameter cost
the same identity skip paths as ResNet18
architecture_metadata.addressed: Shows what depth buys inside one architectural family, which is why the assignment pairs it with ResNet18.

architecture_metadata.name: DenseNet121

feature reuse rather than feature relearning
narrow layers, so parameters stay low despite the connectivity
architecture_metadata.addressed: Took ResNet's skip idea further: concatenate rather than add, so features are reused instead of recomputed.
